title: Best Indoor Exercises for Cold Weather Blood Pressure
description: Cold snaps spike BP by 12–18 mmHg in adults over 45 — learn 6 proven indoor routines that stabilize pressure all winter. Learn how.
primaryKeyword: indoor exercises for cold weather blood pressure
perplexityQuestions: What is the best exercise routine for adults over 35 who have never exercised before?

How many minutes of exercise per day do adults 35-50 need to reverse sedentary damage?

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking articles primarily cover CDC/NHS guidelines for adults 65+ (150 minutes/week aerobic, 2 days strength, balance training), low-impact options like swimming/yoga/tai chi, chair exercises for limited mobility, and four fitness pillars: endurance, strength, balance, flexibility. To compete, a new article must target the 35-64 'pre-senior' gap with age-specific progression plans, address common barriers like back pain or sedentary jobs, and include science-backed muscle-loss prevention strategies for adults under 65.
